'''House Keltal''' was a guild active in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], a city of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Genarius]]. The [[permitor]] [[Sadana]] was affiliated to this house, apparently trying to direct costumers to business also affiliated to the house.

==Behind the scenes==
This organization is not named. However, the character Sadana is sometimes identified as ''Sadana of Keltal'' which seems to be one of the ways a permitor identifies the house he or she is associated with.
